The daemon classifies a push by its paths, never by the trailer, so nothing downstream reads it differently.

The lesson that cost two rounds, for whoever pushes next: push a code commit in a push of its own and the handoff after it. GitHub reads only the head commit's message, so a push carrying code and a trailered handoff together gets no run for either.
